{{Top|fa}} {{Otheruses|Battle of Onderon}} {{Battle |prev=Eventually the [[Battle of Anaxes]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' |conc=*[[Mandalorian Civil War (19 BBY)|Mandalorian Civil War]]{{TCW|Old Friends Not Forgotten}} *[[Battle of Cato Neimoidia]] *[[Battle of Felucia (Outer Rim Sieges)|Battle of Felucia]] *[[Battle of Yerbana]] |next=[[Mission to Onderon (Clone Force 99)|Mission to Onderon]]"[[Aftermath (episode)|Aftermath]]" establishes that the [[Mission to Onderon (Clone Force 99)|mission to Onderon]] occurred in the immediate aftermath of the [[Clone Wars]], the conflict in which the siege at Onderon took place according to "[[The Clone Wars (reference book)|The Clone Wars]]." |image= |name=Siege at Onderon |conflict=[[Clone Wars]] {{C|[[Outer Rim Sieges]]}}{{EncyclopediaCite|The Clone Wars}} |date=[[19 BBY]] |place=[[Onderon]] |result= |side1=*[[Galactic Republic]] **[[Onderon rebels]] |side2=[[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] |side3= |side4= |commanders1= |commanders2= |commanders3= |commanders4= |unit1= |unit2= |unit3= |unit4= |forces1=[[Saw Gerrera]] |forces2= |forces3= |forces4= |casual1= |casual2= |casual3= |casual4= |civilian= }} {{Quote|Perhaps the siege at Onderon has taken a turn for the worse.|Obi-Wan Kenobi speculates that Saw Gerrera requires aid|}} The '''siege at Onderon''' was a late battle of the [[Clone Wars]] fought between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and [[Galactic Republic]] as part of the [[Outer Rim Sieges]] campaign. The battle was waged in [[19 BBY]] for the [[Inner Rim Territories|Inner Rim]] [[planet]] [[Onderon]], which had previously been occupied by the Confederacy until its [[Battle of the Onderon highlands|liberation]] during the [[Onderonian Civil War]] in [[20 BBY]] by the Republic-supported [[Onderon rebels]]. As part of the sieges, the Confederacy attacked Onderon and besieged the planet, returning Onderon to a state of conflict. The battle saw the Onderon rebels—whose ranks included [[Saw Gerrera]], a rebel leader from the still-recent Civil War—once more fight for the Republic. Unfortunately for the rebels, the Republic's [[Proclamation of the New Order|transformation]] into the [[Galactic Empire]] at the end of the Clone Wars created a [[Imperial Era|new era]] of [[Onderon insurgency|conflict on Onderon]]. ==Prelude== {{Quote|My world tried to avoid taking sides in the war, but the Separatists staged a coup in the guise of ''legitimate political action''. To buy our freedom, we threw in with the Republic. It was a good pact, and the Republic gave us the support we needed. Not what we wanted—they wouldn't get their hands dirty—but they trained us, armed us, and we overthrew the Separatists' puppet government and kept fighting after.|Saw Gerrera reflects on his Clone Wars service|''[[Reign of the Empire: The Mask of Fear]]''}} {{Main|Onderonian Civil War}} When the [[Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] (CIS) began''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' in [[22 BBY]], [[King]] [[Ramsis Dendup]] of''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' the historically neutral''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' [[Inner Rim Territories|Inner Rim]] [[planet]] [[Onderon]] decided to remain unaffiliated in the conflict on the belief that both sides were corrupt.{{TCW|The Soft War}} He further believed that such a choice would spare Onderon from the horrors of war.{{Databank|king-sanjay-rash|King Sanjay Rash}} While the planet had been a member of the Republic,{{TCW|Tipping Points}} the [[Onderonian]] people were proud of their neutrality and independence. However, the CIS responded with an [[Invasion of Onderon|invasion]] after staging and covertly supporting a pro-Separatist coup, which brought Separatist puppet King [[Sanjay Rash]] to [[Royal Court of Onderon|power]]. With the puppet king "inviting" the [[Confederacy military]] to Onderon and cementing his power governmentally, the Separatists secured a firm foothold over Onderon through an occupation{{TCW|A War on Two Fronts}} and a reformed government. [[File:Saw_dodges_battle_droids.jpg|thumb|left|300px|When the Confederacy of Independent Systems occupied Onderon under a puppet king, a civilian insurgency emerged to retake the planet.]] Although Onderon's representative in the [[Separatist Senate]], [[Mina Bonteri]],''[[The Star Wars Book]]'' firmly believed in the Separatist cause,{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}} the Confederacy's violation of Onderonian sovereignty inspired a [[Onderon rebels|resistance movement]] of citizens under siblings [[Steela Gerrera|Steela]] and [[Saw Gerrera]]. The ensuing [[Onderonian Civil War]] lasted from 22 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]] to [[20 BBY]].{{OnderonianCivilWarDate}} In the latter [[Standard year|year]],{{TCWcanondates|502}} the Onderon rebels formally approached the [[Jedi High Council]] for help in overthrowing Rash. Unable to directly interfere with the affairs of a planet with a history of neutrality and that had chosen to align with the CIS, as the Republic recognized Rash's rule, [[Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] proposed a covert operation to train and support the local insurgency. The rebels agreed to fight for the Republic but only in the name of ensuring their own freedom and that of their rightful king. Although Steela [[Death|gave her life]] in the [[Battle of the Onderon highlands|final battle]], the Separatists were ultimately ousted from Onderon, with Rash being [[Death penalty|executed]] for his failure by [[General]] [[Kalani]] on the order of Confederate [[Head of State]] [[Count]] [[Dooku]]. As Mina's [[Reproduction|son]], [[Lux Bonteri]], who had lost faith in the Separatist cause after Dooku had his [[Parent|mother]] [[Attack on Confederate people|killed]],{{TCW|A Friend in Need}} promised during [[Funeral of Steela Gerrera|Steela's funeral]], Onderon then returned to the Republic. Lux served as its senator{{Databank|text=Lux Bonteri Biography Gallery|url=lux-bonteri-biography-gallery}} {{C|Slide 22}} while Dendup returned to the [[throne]]. The people of Onderon remained loyal to the Republic for the rest of the war. While it had overthrown Rash's regime, the Onderon resistance remained in operation as recognized Republic fighters{{TBB|Aftermath (episode)}} who continued fighting for that government, striking at a seemingly never-ending series of Separatist targets with Republic-supplied equipment. Nonetheless, Saw established himself as an Onderonian hero instead of a mere Republic-backed insurgent. ==The siege== {{Quote|Sir, we've received a transmission from someone using your subspace frequency Fulcrum.''"
"''Saw Gerrera?|Wullf Yularen and Anakin Skywalker, during the Battle of Yerbana|}} [[File:SawGerrera19BBY.png|thumb|right|300px|The tireless freedom fighter Saw Gerrera (center) fought in the siege at Onderon.]] Toward the end of the Clone WarsThe events of "[[Old Friends Not Forgotten]]" overlap with the [[Battle of Coruscant]], which [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] establishes to occur late into the [[Clone Wars]]. Therefore, the events of "Old Friends Not Forgotten" must occur late into the war as well. in [[19 BBY]], General [[Grievous]] launched a major Separatist offensive during the [[Outer Rim Sieges]], the final campaign of the Clone Wars.{{SW|url=a-distant-echo-trivia-gallery|text=Tech's Notes: "A Distant Echo" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 3}} As part of the sieges, the Confederacy attacked{{EncyclopediaCite|Saw Gerrera and Other Characters of the Galaxy}} and besieged the recently-liberated Onderon, battling with the Republic-supported Onderon rebels and turning the planet into a battlefront once more. Just as he had in the Civil War, the tireless Gerrera fought on behalf of the Republic during the siege. Even so, he still saw his service as something done for the sake of Onderon instead of the Republic. The battle was dubbed the "siege at Onderon." In the final [[Standard day|days]] of the war, Gerrera also began to use Skywalker's [[Fulcrum]] frequency to keep in contact with the [[Jedi]]. During the [[Battle of Yerbana]], when former Jedi [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Mandalorian]] [[Bo-Katan Kryze]] contacted the Republic using the Fulcrum frequency for [[Siege of Mandalore|help]] in the [[Mandalorian Civil War (19 BBY)|Mandalorian Civil War]], Skywalker and fellow Jedi General [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] initially thought Gerrera was trying to contact them, with the latter speculating that Gerrera's efforts had taken a negative turn. However, [[Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen]] informed the Jedi it was not Gerrera contacting them, and the two soon learned that it was instead Tano and Kryze. ==Aftermath== {{Quote|I fought for the Republic because I wanted to free my king and my world. I succeeded at the first, but when Palpatine declared himself Emperor it was clear I'd failed at the second. Orders came telling us to surrender our weapons, the names of our allies, to the governor assigned to our system. ''[…]'' I knew if I gave up fighting, everything we did—everyone we lost—would have been for nothing. One battle leads to the next. Strategies change. The Clone Wars may have ended, but another civil war is about to begin—which means we all have a decision to make: You can either adapt and survive, or die with the past.|Saw Gerrera|}} {{Main|Onderon insurgency}} The Clone Wars came to an end when Skywalker, as the newly-christened [[Sith apprentice]] [[Darth]] Vader, [[Mission to Mustafar|wiped out]] the [[Executive Separatist Council]] on the planet [[Mustafar]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories]]. Vader also sent out a shutdown signal to the Confederacy military, leaving the [[Separatist Droid Army]] to cease its ongoing attacks and stop in its tracks.''[[Catalyst: A Rogue One Novel]]'' However, the end of the war did not mark the end of Gerrera's troubles but instead saw the [[Proclamation of the New Order|reformation]] of the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire]] by [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]], secretly the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] Darth Sidious, betraying Gererra's ideals. As Palpatine, Sidious also sent out [[Order 66]] to the [[clone trooper]]s who served alongside the Jedi, forcing the [[Cloning|clones]] to wipe out their own [[commanding officer]]s because of the [[behavioral modification biochip]]s installed in their [[brain]]s. Feeling that Palpatine was another tyrant who had taken power for himself, just like Rash had on Onderon, Gerrera recognized that Palpatine had unlimited control over the clones and believed a new [[Galactic Civil War|civil war]] was imminent. Believing that, in the end, he had failed to free Onderon, Gerrera felt as though the sacrifices of his comrades during the Clone Wars—including that of his sister—would be for nothing if he gave up his fight. Even though Gerrera had been promised that Onderon would be free after the war, the Empire moved to [[Annexation of Onderon|annex]] the world.''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' For the first few [[Standard day|days]] of the [[Imperial Era]], the Onderon resistance remained silent as the Empire tried to take control, but Gerrera and his remaining fighters ultimately decided they would not fight for the new regime despite their work with the Republic so as to maintain Onderon's independence. [[File:Gerrera_speaks_to_the_Bad_Batch.png|thumb|left|300px|In the aftermath of the Clone Wars, Saw Gerrera encountered Clone Force 99 and urged them to rethink their loyalties.]] As such, they were dubbed enemies of the state and seen as a threat in the opening days of the Imperial Era, during which time Gerrera's resistance fighters fled into the dense Onderon forests. Gerrera reformed the Onderon rebels into an anti-Imperial rebel cell named the [[Partisans]] and protected a number of civilians. His fighters soon [[Mission to Onderon (Clone Force 99)|captured]] an elite team of clones—[[Clone Force 99]], otherwise known as the "Bad Batch"—that had been dispatched by Imperial Admiral [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] on the claim that they would find Separatist insurgents. Gerrera urged the clones to resist the new Imperial government before letting them go. Declaring their [[Campaigns of Saw Gerrera's Partisans|own war]] against the Empire, Gerrera and his Partisans waged a [[Onderon insurgency|brutal insurgency]] for the future of Onderon but ultimately abandoned the world. A few weeks into the Imperial Era, Gerrera reflected on his service to the Republic in conversation with Separatist fighter [[Soujen Vak-Nhalis]], including making reference to his continued Republic service after the Civil War. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:Star_Wars_The_Clone_Wars_Season_7_poster_2.jpg|thumb|right|190px|The siege at Onderon was introduced via mention in ''Star Wars The Clone Wars''{{'s}} seventh season.]] The siege at Onderon was first mentioned in "[[Old Friends Not Forgotten]]," the ninth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Seven|seventh and final]] season of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', released on [[April 17]], [[2020]].{{DisneyPlus|subdomain=press|url=disney-plus/star-wars-the-clone-wars/709|text=Episode 709 "Old Friends Not Forgotten"}} According to the ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia (series)|Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' issue "[[The Clone Wars (reference book)|The Clone Wars]]," which was first released by [[De Agostini]] on [[September 7]], [[2021]],{{DeAgostini|url=libros-comics/enciclopedia-star-wars|text=Star Wars Encyclopedia}} the siege at Onderon was launched against the Separatists by the Onderon rebels despite the world's recent liberation from CIS control. However, the De Agostini encyclopedia "[[Saw Gerrera and Other Characters of the Galaxy]]"—which was first published on [[August 26]], [[2022]]{{Altaya|lang=fr|url=livres-bd/encyclopedie-star-wars|text=Official Star Wars Encyclopedia}}—had framed the battle as a Separatist attack against Onderon. Indeed, the [[2023]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' stated that the siege was launched against Onderon by the Confederacy. As such, this article assumes "The Clone Wars" encyclopedia is incorrect. ==Appearances== *{{TCW|Old Friends Not Forgotten}} {{1stm}} *''[[Reign of the Empire: The Mask of Fear]]'' {{Ab|Reign of the Empire: The Mask of Fear (audiobook)}} {{Imo}} ==Sources== *{{EncyclopediaCite|The Clone Wars}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|Saw Gerrera and Other Characters of the Galaxy}} *''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' ==Notes and references== {{ScrollBox|content={{Reflist}}}} {{CanonCloneWarsNav}} {{Interlang |es=Asedio en Onderon }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Onderon, Siege at}} [[Category:Battles of Onderon]] [[Category:Battles of the Outer Rim Sieges]]
